page.title: Hodgkin lymphoma
about: Hodgkin lymphoma is an uncommon cancer that affects the white blood cells that help you fight infection (lymphocytes).
The main symptom of Hodgkin lymphoma is a painless lump in your armpit, neck or groin. Other symptoms include a high temperature and night sweats.
